{{Modifier|GradiantDetails=to bottom, #00FFFF, #00AAAA|TextColor=#DDFFFF|Name=[[Legacy Mode]]|Details=The version of R:FF before it was closed. This modifier will very rarely be updated, and may break at times. [[Section I]] and old entities can be found here.}}

==Overview==
'''Legacy Mode''' is a modifier that allows you to play the Original '''Rooms: Found Footage''' like it was right before it was Permanently closed. This mode isn't much different then the main game, one main change though is Section Interchange, aka [[Section I]], being present in the mode, it Being the original [[Section M]].
